---
title: "student_lab_02"
format: html
---

```{r}
ggplot(anes, aes(x = ideology)) +
geom_bar(fill = "lightpink") +
labs(
title = "Distribution of Respondents' Ideology",
x = "Ideology (1 = Liberal, 7 = Conservative)",
y = "Number of Respondents"
) +
theme_minimal()

ggplot(na.omit(anes), aes(x = factor(ideology), fill = urbanrural)) +
geom_bar(position = "fill") +
labs(
title = "Ideology by Urban/Rural Residence",
x = "Ideology (1 = Liberal, 7 = Conservative)",
y = "Proportion of Respondents",
fill = "Urban/Rural"
) +
theme_minimal()
table(anes$ideology, useNA = "ifany")
mean(is.na(anes$ideology))

ggplot(na.omit(anes), aes(x = scientists)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "skyblue", color = "white") +
labs(
title = "Distribution of Feelings Toward Scientists",
x = "Feeling Thermometer Score (0–100)",
y = "Number of Respondents"
) +
theme_minimal()

anes |>
drop_na(hunt_fish, ideology) |>
mutate(hunted_fished = ifelse(hunt_fish == 0, "Did Not Hunt or Fish",
"Hunted or Fished")) |>
ggplot(aes(x = hunted_fished, y = ideology, fill = hunted_fished)) +
geom_boxplot() +
labs(
title = "Ideology by Hunting or Fishing Behavior",
x = "Hunting/Fishing Status",
y = "Ideology (1 = Liberal, 7 = Conservative)",
fill = "Group"
) +
theme_minimal()

anes |>
drop_na(hunt_fish) |>
mutate(hunted_fished = ifelse(hunt_fish == 0, "Did Not Hunt or Fish",
"Hunted or Fished")) |>
ggplot(aes(x = ideology, y = hunted_fished, fill = hunted_fished)) +
geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1) +
labs(
title = "Distribution of Ideology by Hunting/Fishing Behavior",
x = "Ideology (1 = Liberal, 7 = Conservative)",
y = "Group",
fill = "Hunting/Fishing Status"
) +
theme_minimal()

ggplot(na.omit(anes), aes(x = education, y = scientists)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue") +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "hotpink", se = TRUE) +
labs(
title = "Relationship Between Education and Feelings Toward Scientists",
x = "Education Level",
y = "View of Scientists (0–100)"
) +
theme_minimal()

anes |>
drop_na(education, ideology) |>
mutate(
ideology_strength = abs(ideology - 4),
education_f = as.factor(education)
) |>
ggplot(aes(x = education_f, y = ideology_strength, fill = education_f)) +
geom_boxplot() +
labs(
title = "Ideological Strength by Education Level",
x = "Education Level",
y = "Ideological Strength (Distance from Moderate = 4)",
fill = "Education Level"
) +
theme_minimal()
```
